comment: Per-chunk gzip-size ceilings in bytes, checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs after `vite build`. A chunk fails the gate when it exceeds its budget by more than slopPercent. Chunk keys are name prefixes ("index" matches index-AbC123.js). Initial ceilings were set ~5% above the first measured build with CodeMirror + Milkdown in place; re-pin deliberately when a feature grows a chunk, so the diff in this file is what reviewers see. Chunks without an entry are reported but never fail.
